summary: Implemented custom global generators loaded by name from the cache's extensions/generators folder. Changes: conans/client/cache/cache.py adds GENERATORS_EXTENSION_FOLDER and a generators_path property; conans/client/generators/__init__.py adds custom lookup (built-ins take priority; custom classes must be defined in a .py file in that folder and match the generator name; load errors raise ConanException) and write_generators now takes an optional cache argument; conans/client/installer.py (two call sites) and conan/api/subapi/install.py pass the cache. Not run or tested, as instructed; no tests or docs added; nothing committed.
